We develop self-contained training modules on topics ranging from data visualisation with `ggplot2` to R package development. These modules are also used in our [Workshops](../workshops/). Existing modules from our past workshops can be found [here](https://workshop.palaeoverse.org/){target="_blank"}.

Coming soon:

* Visualizing your data with the grammar of graphics
* Using Palaeoverse packages
* R package development
* Many more modules!

Check again in late 2026!
